messages:
maria (product): quick sync — proposing a lightweight protocol for matching design partners into the private beta + how we collect structured feedback. want to get this ready before next wed.

jon (eng-ml): sounds good. what are the slot targets?

maria (product): aiming for 10–12 partners per cohort. mix of: 50% infra/platform, 30% product/consumer apps, 20% regulated (health/finance).

elaine (design): +1 on cohort mix. also we should avoid putting two partners building the same product vertical in one cohort to reduce noise.

sanjay (sales): FYI I have 3 customers interested in dedicated/private who asked for higher SLA details. can we keep 2 slots reserved for high-touch pilots?

maria (product): yes — reserve 2 "high-touch" slots (sales-led). rest are product-led invites.

greg (ops): we need to lock onboarding windows for private deployments — provisioning lead time ~5 business days. keep that in the intake checklist.

anna (cs): onboarding checklist item: support onboarding call + 7-day follow-up survey. I'll own the onboarding flow.

jon (eng-ml): for feedback loops — propose: weekly async threads + biweekly 1hr review with 2 engineering reps and 1 product rep.

elaine (design): and a short 5-question usability micro-survey after each major task. quick hits: task completion, confusion points, friction severity.

maria (product): agreed. success metrics we should track: engagement (DAU for pilot portal), feature adoption (percent using new endpoint), latency/regression alerts, qualitative satisfaction (NPS-ish). target thresholds: engagement >= 30% DAU over cohort, feature adoption >= 40% by week 4, no major regression alerts.

sanjay (sales): does adoption include traffic routed through our fallback policies? some customers want to test fallback behavior.

jon (eng-ml): include both primary and fallback traffic, but tag fallback usage so we can separate metrics.

maria (product): screening form draft (for outreach). please review:
```
Company name:
Primary use case (1-2 sentences):
Expected weekly requests (tokens / calls):
Privacy requirements (PII, regulated):
Willingness to run small evals (Y/N):
Assign a technical contact + timezone:
Preference: high-touch (sales) or self-serve (product):
```

elaine (design): add a question about how they define "success" for the pilot. helps later when we evaluate.

maria (product): good call — will add.

anna (cs): cadence for feedback collection:
- Day 0: kickoff call (30–45m)
- Day 3: quick health check (email + slack)
- Weekly: async feedback thread (structured template)
- Week 2 & 4: short survey + usage snapshot
- End: retrospective + handoff doc

jon (eng-ml): about structured templates — propose this minimal template to capture regression signals:
```
1) Scenario tested
2) Expected vs actual outputs (one example)
3) Severity (minor/major/blocker)
4) Repro steps
5) Attach prompt/inputs (redact secrets)
```

greg (ops): ops constraints: make sure private beta VPC deployments have dedicated logging retention set to 90 days and allow export to customer S3. that'll be a gating item for legal/compliance.

maria (product): legal + security signoff required for regulated partners. add to gating checklist.

sanjay (sales): timeline ask: can we start outreach next mon and run the cohort for 6 weeks? customers want clear dates.

maria (product): proposed timeline: outreach start Mon 3524740000 (next week), onboarding week after, cohort weeks 1–4 active testing, week 5 retrospective & handoff. total 6 weeks end-to-end.

elaine (design): how are we routing feedback into prioritization? need a lightweight scoring rubric for asks vs. bugs.

maria (product): rubric idea: impact (1–5) x severity (1–5) and signal source (design partner flag doubles score). anything > 12 gets immediate triage.

jon (eng-ml): include "repro rate" as modifier — if multiple partners report same regression, escalate automatically.

anna (cs): I'll own the weekly async thread template and aggregate spreadsheet. will share a view-only link once ready.

maria (product): action items:
- anna: build weekly thread template + aggregate sheet (due in 48h)
- jon: add fallback tagging to metrics pipeline (due EOW)
- greg: add provisioning SLA and logging export step to onboarding checklist (due 48h)
- elaine: finalize micro-survey + success-def question (due 48h)
- sanjay: confirm two high-touch candidates and get permission to invite (due 24h)

sanjay (sales): will confirm candidates today.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: private-beta-provisioner v1.2 -> staging (ci-352468) :white_check_mark:

maria (product): perfect — once anna shares the sheet, i'll draft outreach copy and NDA + intake form. aiming to send invites by next mon. thanks all :rocket:
